capabilities.name: Deep knowledge
capabilities.definition: Knows the important things in each subject well enough to use them, explain them and build on them.

groups.name: Number and measure
groups.can: I can work with numbers, shapes and measures accurately.

stages.Foundational: I can count, add and take away small numbers and tell how long, heavy or full something is.
stages.Preparatory: I can work with large numbers, fractions and measures, and check that my answer makes sense.

groups.name: Language and reading
groups.can: I can read, write and speak the languages I learn, and understand what I read.

stages.Foundational: I can sound out and read simple words and sentences and say what a short story is about.
stages.Preparatory: I can read a longer text, find what it says directly and what it only hints at, and write about it in my own words.

groups.name: How the world works
groups.can: I can say what I know about living things, materials, places and people, and how I know it.

stages.Foundational: I can name living things, materials and places around me and say one thing I noticed about each.
stages.Preparatory: I can explain how something in nature, in my place or in the past works, and name where my knowledge came from.

capabilities.name: Reasoning from evidence
capabilities.definition: Works out what is true or likely by looking at evidence, patterns and numbers, and changes position when the evidence changes.

groups.name: Weighing evidence
groups.can: I can tell what I know from what I guess, and give a reason.

stages.Foundational: I can say how I know something and whether I saw it or only think it.
stages.Preparatory: I can separate a fact from an opinion, and give two reasons for something I believe.

groups.name: Patterns and numbers
groups.can: I can find a pattern, say its rule and use the rule.

stages.Foundational: I can spot a repeating or growing pattern and say what comes next.
stages.Preparatory: I can say the rule of a pattern in my own words, use it to predict a far-away step and check my prediction.

groups.name: Changing my mind
groups.can: I can change my mind when I meet a better reason, and say so.

stages.Foundational: I can listen to another idea and say if it is different from mine.
stages.Preparatory: I can say what made me change my mind, and that changing it was good thinking, not a mistake.

capabilities.name: Learning and agency
capabilities.definition: Takes charge of their own learning: sets a goal, tries, asks, keeps going after a wrong answer and gets better.

groups.name: Setting and reaching goals
groups.can: I can decide what I want to learn or finish, and keep at it until I get there.

stages.Foundational: I can say what I want to do today and finish it with some help.
stages.Preparatory: I can set a goal for the week, plan the steps, and tell whether I reached it.

groups.name: Trying, asking and keeping going
groups.can: I can try something new, ask when I am stuck, and keep going after a wrong answer.

stages.Foundational: I can try something new, put up my hand when I am stuck and try again after a wrong answer.
stages.Preparatory: I can try a hard problem on my own first, ask a clear question when I am stuck, and use a wrong answer to find out what to change.

groups.name: Looking back and improving
groups.can: I can say what went well, what did not, and what I will change next time.

stages.Foundational: I can show my work to someone and say one thing I would do differently.
stages.Preparatory: I can look at my work and feedback, say what I will change, and show it improved.

capabilities.name: Making and solving
capabilities.definition: Turns a question or a problem into something real: an investigation, a design, a made thing.

groups.name: Investigating
groups.can: I can ask a question, test it fairly and say what I found.

stages.Foundational: I can ask a question about something I see, try one thing out and say what happened.
stages.Preparatory: I can ask a question, change one thing at a time, record what happens and say what it shows.

groups.name: Designing and building
groups.can: I can make something that solves a problem, test it, and improve it.

stages.Foundational: I can make something from materials, try it out and say what I would change.
stages.Preparatory: I can plan a design, build it, test it more than once after it fails, and show what I improved.

groups.name: Imagining and expressing
groups.can: I can make art, music, stories or movement that are my own.

stages.Foundational: I can draw, sing, move or tell a story in my own way and share it.
stages.Preparatory: I can make a piece of art, music, writing or drama with my own ideas, and say how I made my choices.

capabilities.name: Communicating and working together
capabilities.definition: Says and writes what they mean clearly, listens to others, and does their part in a team without losing their own judgment.

groups.name: Speaking and listening
groups.can: I can say what I mean and listen to what others mean.

stages.Foundational: I can speak in a sentence so others hear me, and listen without talking while someone else speaks.
stages.Preparatory: I can explain my idea clearly to a group, listen to others, and say back what they said.

groups.name: Writing and showing my work
groups.can: I can write and show my work so others can follow it.

stages.Foundational: I can write a sentence or two and show my work to my class.
stages.Preparatory: I can write in paragraphs for a purpose and present my work to others, answering their questions.

groups.name: Working in a team
groups.can: I can do my part, take turns and help the team finish.

stages.Foundational: I can take turns, share materials and do my part in a pair or small group.
stages.Preparatory: I can agree a plan with my team, do my part on time, and help a team-mate who is stuck.

capabilities.name: Technology and AI
capabilities.definition: Uses digital tools and AI as tools: makes good use of them, checks what they say before trusting it, and stays safe and fair.

groups.name: Using digital tools
groups.can: I can use a digital tool to learn, make or find something out.

stages.Foundational: I can use a device the way an educator shows me to draw, listen or look something up.
stages.Preparatory: I can choose a digital tool for a job, use it well and say why I chose it.

groups.name: Checking before I trust
groups.can: I can check whether what a screen or an AI tells me is true, and who made it.

stages.Foundational: I can say that a picture or a story on a screen may not be true, and ask an adult.
stages.Preparatory: I can check an answer from a screen or an AI against a book or another source, and say what it got wrong or left out.

groups.name: Staying safe and fair online
groups.can: I can keep myself and others safe, and respect other people's work.

stages.Foundational: I can say what I should never share, and tell an adult if something online worries me.
stages.Preparatory: I can protect my privacy, name the source when I use someone's work, and treat others online as I would face to face.

capabilities.name: Self and others
capabilities.definition: Understands and looks after their own feelings and body, notices other people, and acts for them even when it costs something.

groups.name: My feelings and my body
groups.can: I can name how I feel, calm myself and look after my body.

stages.Foundational: I can name how I feel, take a breath to calm down and move my body in different ways.
stages.Preparatory: I can say what made me feel a strong feeling, choose a way to calm myself, and keep my body healthy and fit.

groups.name: Caring for others
groups.can: I can notice how others feel and help them, even when it costs me something.

stages.Foundational: I can notice when a friend is sad or left out and do something kind.
stages.Preparatory: I can notice what someone needs, help them, and keep helping even when it is hard for me.

groups.name: Speaking up
groups.can: I can say when I disagree or when something is not fair, politely and clearly.

stages.Foundational: I can say "no" or "stop" kindly, and tell an educator when something is not right.
stages.Preparatory: I can disagree politely with a friend or an adult, give my reason, and speak up for someone else.

capabilities.name: Society, ethics and planet
capabilities.definition: Looks beyond themselves: how people live together, what is fair, and what a choice does to others and to nature.

groups.name: Fairness and living together
groups.can: I can say what is fair and take part in making our shared rules.

stages.Foundational: I can follow our class rules and say if something is fair or not fair.
stages.Preparatory: I can help make a rule for our group, say who it helps and who it may not, and keep it.

groups.name: Choices and consequences
groups.can: I can say what happens because of a choice, to people and to nature.

stages.Foundational: I can say what happens next when we make a choice, such as sharing or not sharing.
stages.Preparatory: I can follow a choice to its results for different people, and weigh the good and the bad of each.

groups.name: Caring for nature
groups.can: I can look after living things, places and what we use.

stages.Foundational: I can water a plant, put things where they belong and say why that matters.
stages.Preparatory: I can look after a place, measure what we use, and suggest one way to waste less.
